description: This Perl module defines the class Git::SVN::Fetcher, a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor, implementing callbacks to process Subversion deltas for integration with git-svn. It manages file and directory changes, properties, empty directories, and placeholders, facilitating synchronization between SVN and Git repositories.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor that processes SVN tree deltas to update the git-svn index, handle properties, empty directories, and placeholders for efficient repository synchronization.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Fetcher object with configuration from git-svn, including ignore/include regexes, placeholder filename, and empty directory handling.

methods.name: _mark_empty_symlinks
methods.description: Identifies empty symlinks in the repository to treat them accordingly during fetch operations.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a '.git' directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be ignored based on ignore/include regexes and '.git' directories.

methods.name: set_path_strip
methods.description: Sets a prefix path to be stripped from paths during processing.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Initializes processing at the root of the repository.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Initializes processing of a directory at a given path.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a repository-specific path to a git-compatible path, applying encoding and path stripping.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of files or directories, updating the index and managing placeholders.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Initializes processing for a file at a given path, retrieving its mode and blob ID from git.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a new file entry to the index, handling placeholders if necessary.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Adds a new directory, ensuring empty directories are processed and placeholders are handled.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records changes to directory properties.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Marks a directory as absent (could not be conveyed).

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Marks a file as absent (could not be conveyed).

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Records changes to file properties such as executable flag and symlinks.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Applies text delta to a file, managing temporary files and hash verification.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes editing a file, commits its new blob to the index, and handles symlinks.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts editing, cleaning up state.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the delta processing, handles empty directories and placeholders, and cleans up state.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Detects directories that have become empty after deletions to add placeholders.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Creates a placeholder file in an empty directory to retain its presence.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of placeholder files into git config for persistence.
